summary: Preserve degraded run bounds across later receipts and retire replay fences after successful full repair.

replay.detail: Canonical claim folding is unchanged; failed run folds remain excluded until authorized full repair.

schema.detail: Persist local keyed degraded-run-root membership in existing meta rows. This branch also adds naming expression indexes, the degraded-subject partial index, generation triggers, naming scope keys, discovery watermark/fence rows and deferred-replay rows.

rules.detail: Later ordinary claims cannot enqueue or directly rebuild an already-degraded run tree. Tree and part rebuild entrypoints fail closed before hydration; a failed part conservatively excludes its owning root.

compatibility.detail: Local persisted projection metadata changes; no wire format changes.

manual.detail: Repair remains fractal replication replay --confirm in a planned window.

recovery.detail: Successful authorized full repair atomically clears run exclusions and replay fence evidence and advances discovery to its repaired store index/source generation. Canonical operation conflicts remain recorded.

downtime.detail: No additional index build or deployment downtime is introduced by this correction.
